metadata.description: Public AI agent skills — practical skills spanning multiple domains, from engineering, idea validation all the way to knowledge management.

plugins.name: architect
plugins.description: Turn a fuzzy systems/infra requirement into a self-contained, agent-executable architecture work package, then execute it, with scaffolding, a deterministic graph-engineering step, a completeness linter, and optional code-graph grounding.

plugins.name: prose-craft
plugins.description: Compose or revise clear, well-architected prose grounded in Strunk & White's concision and Pinker's classic style, with optional voice matching.

plugins.name: forge-idea
plugins.description: Forge rough ideas into viable ones through cooperative, research-driven iteration.

plugins.name: llm-wiki
plugins.description: Create, maintain, and query a personal knowledge wiki designed for LLM navigation.

plugins.name: rust-engineer
plugins.description: Enforce Rust code quality and guidelines throughout Rust development.

plugins.name: code-quality
plugins.description: Audits code for risk using complexity, coverage, structural metrics, and comment quality instead of a line-by-line read.

plugins.name: project-docs
plugins.description: Give any project a standard, enforceable docs/ structure (overview, optional spec, ADRs) with diagrams and an AGENTS.md pointer, then validate it stays conformant.

plugins.name: unslop
plugins.description: Edit writing to remove AI tells and restore a plain, human voice — for docs, READMEs, commits, and posts.

plugins.name: agent-extension-author
plugins.description: Author, port, and harden agent Skills (SKILL.md) across Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and oh-my-pi — with programmatic triggering, native plugin packaging, multi-agent workflows, and an eval harness.

plugins.name: nix
plugins.description: Operate correctly inside Nix + direnv development repos — dev-shell entry, nix fmt over cargo fmt, the result-symlink and crane-rustflags build traps, and a lightweight pre-commit override.

plugins.name: github-actions
plugins.description: Harden GitHub Actions workflows and configure Renovate — template-injection prevention, SHA-pinned actions, scoped permissions, zizmor, and dependency-bot rules.

plugins.name: find-ai-moat
plugins.description: Interview one question at a time to find where your work complements AI versus where a model already does it, then give three concrete 30-day moves to widen the gap in your favor.

plugins.name: orchestrate
plugins.description: Coordinate several agents on one shared goal through a shared work board: orchestrate:pull (alias swarm, peer-to-peer) and orchestrate:assign (alias direct, thin dispatcher), with shared claim/lease/reap mechanics, charter, escalation ladder and role cards.

plugins.name: decompose
plugins.description: Cut a goal into units that agents can work on in parallel (seams, write-sets, acceptance tests, tiers), check the cut with the graph-engine, and file the units as work items in dependency order.

plugins.name: dep-pr-triage
plugins.description: Triage open Dependabot and Renovate PRs across orgs: classify each red check, apply the mechanical fix on the PR branch, push, re-check. Never merges or approves.

plugins.name: graph-engine
plugins.description: Work-division engine: from units with dependencies and write-sets, compute collision-free parallel waves, the critical path, and barriers.

plugins.name: grounded-research
plugins.description: Research a question under a fixed evidence contract: primary sources first, every claim cited with URL and date, fact kept apart from hearsay.

plugins.name: policy
plugins.description: The shared .agents/policy format and loader: layered (global plus per-repo), open, with a basic default.

plugins.name: ramble
plugins.description: Turn a rough idea into an aligned, gap-closed brief for the architect through a relentless grilling interview.

plugins.name: review-gauntlet
plugins.description: Run a block of build work through red-first roles and a read-only four-angle review gauntlet that reports findings without editing.

plugins.name: session-retrospective
plugins.description: Mine agent sessions for the moments the agent struggled, then propose fixes to the skills, environment, and workflows it used.

plugins.name: typescript-engineer
plugins.description: Enforce TypeScript and JavaScript code quality and house guidelines on every TS/JS change.
